column6: OneUI 8.5 finally started to roll out for S24 users globally! 🎉

## **Stable OneUI 8.5** has released today for:
- S24 series globally (including the S24 FE)
- S23 in South Korea (including the S23 FE)
- Z-Flip/Z-Fold 5 in South Korea
- A56 in South Korea
- A36 in South Korea

What an amazing day 🥳
If you have one of these devices and are in the supported regions, download the update! It brings many new improvements, including better camera processing 😄

The devices who got the update in SK today are expected to roll out globally next week monday (<@804393955533914142> which means it'll be your turn next week)\nStill wish Samsung would just release software to all their devices globally on the same day. :/
